|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Darth Maul, Lone Hunter (ALT) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V3-D-darthmaullonehunter_ai-2022-01-07.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''Errata mark:''' the first image of this Alternate Image card already prints “E”: the mark follows the errata count of the card's text (the regular card had been errata'd before this image was made), but this image is the first version of the Alternate Image card. Recorded as printed and listed with the [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription errors]] (marks that do not match the version).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 7 January 2022<ref name="img-darthmaullonehunter_8ba25cd">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/darthmaullonehunter_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8ba25cdb109b5da73d1397712bcc202e4a11ee69 commit 8ba25cd] (7 January 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/darthmaullonehunter_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
